description: This file defines the RequestFactory class in the league/oauth2-client library. The class provides methods to create PSR-7 Request instances, parse options, and generate requests using simplified options. It primarily facilitates constructing HTTP requests for OAuth2 client implementations.

classes.name: RequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class used to produce PSR-7 Request instances, with methods to create requests directly or via simplified options.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 Request instance with specified method, URI, headers, body, and version.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and merges simplified options with default request parameters.

methods.name: getRequestWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a Request using a simplified array of options, combining defaults and provided options.
